svg.title: Flare SM70 prefill and time to first token
svg.desc: Time to first token against prompt length on one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB, release binary d4ffb1fa, 2026-10-23, uncached prompts: 2,048 tokens: 2.54 s and 807 tok/s alone, 9.89 s and 796 tok/s aggregate with four; 8,192 tokens: 10.43 s and 785 tok/s alone, 41.44 s and 782 tok/s aggregate with four; 22,528 tokens: 30.39 s and 741 tok/s alone, 121.11 s and 741 tok/s aggregate with four; 30,720 tokens: 42.75 s and 719 tok/s alone, 170.49 s and 719 tok/s aggregate with four. Concurrent prefills do not overlap. With the opt-in prefill ordering (off by default; lab build dd7533f1, 2026-10-24), four concurrent 30,720-token prompts get their first tokens at 42.73, 85.49, 128.24 and 171.00 s instead of all at 170.11 to 170.78 s. Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md, prefill-summary.json.
